name: genseo
description: Track AI visibility, research SEO opportunities, and publish approved content through Genseo.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Genseo account to inspect AI visibility, tracked prompts, competitors, cited sources, SEO opportunities, audits, and drafts, then publish approved content with role and Agent Autonomy controls.
defaultPrompt: List my accessible Genseo projects and ask which one to use.
Show my AI visibility trend, competitors, and most-cited sources.
Create an SEO draft, but do not publish it.

positive.description: Identify the connected account and list accessible projects. Prerequisite: the reviewer account has at least one accessible non-sensitive sample project.
positive.prompt: List my accessible Genseo projects and ask which one I want to use. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Both reads succeed. List only projects returned for the connected account and ask for explicit selection without silently choosing. An authentication/server error is a failure, not an empty project list. Same-name projects remain distinct; use project IDs or distinguishing details when needed. Exact wording and project counts can change.

positive.description: Run in a fresh chat using the reviewer account. First list accessible projects, then wait for the reviewer to select one explicitly. Continue this same scenario after selection; no context from another test is required. Use stored data only. The chosen project must have stored visibility results. Reviewer setup: the account must have access to the populated Heyflow project d83b8319-d937-4cea-ac83-24d8f8670eb8 (heyflow.com); do not use another same-name project. After the project-selection question, reply exactly: "Use Heyflow project d83b8319-d937-4cea-ac83-24d8f8670eb8." Then request: "Show the stored data for the last 30 days. Do not start tracking or a recheck." Verify this fixture is still accessible before review; access errors must not be treated as empty data.
positive.prompt: Show my Genseo AI visibility trend, competitors and cited sources using stored data only. First list my projects and ask which one to use, then continue after I choose. Do not start tracking or a recheck.
positive.expected_behavior: After explicit selection, pass that project_id and days=30. Report the returned period, visibility KPI and available trend points, competitor names and cited source domains. Values must match the tool response; missing comparisons must be described as unavailable. No tracking, generation or writes. Compare each metric to its corresponding response field, not to another aggregation: overview and competitor metrics may differ. Distinguish completed prompts from completed checks. Calculate changes only from returned comparable points. Live values are not fixed acceptance thresholds.

positive.description: Run in a fresh chat using the reviewer account. First list accessible projects, then wait for the reviewer to select one explicitly. Continue this same scenario after selection; no context from another test is required. Use stored data only. The chosen project must contain at least one active sample prompt. Reviewer setup: the account must have access to the populated Heyflow project d83b8319-d937-4cea-ac83-24d8f8670eb8 (heyflow.com); do not use another same-name project. After the project-selection question, reply exactly: "Use Heyflow project d83b8319-d937-4cea-ac83-24d8f8670eb8." Verify this fixture is still accessible before review; access errors must not be treated as empty data.
positive.prompt: Show my existing active Genseo visibility prompts. First list my projects and ask which one to use, then continue after I choose. Do not create, edit, archive or track anything.
positive.expected_behavior: After explicit selection, use that project_id and status=active. Show returned prompt texts and only available stored metrics. Do not include archived prompts or invent results. No mutations or tracking requests. A clearly labeled partial list is acceptable; do not imply it is the full list. Counts must come from returned totals or complete pagination. Repeated texts with distinct IDs are distinct records; claim duplicates only when supported by returned records.

positive.description: Run in a fresh chat using the reviewer account. First list accessible projects, then wait for the reviewer to select one explicitly. Continue this same scenario after selection; no context from another test is required. Use stored data only. Include stored audits/issues when available; an empty response has its own explicit outcome. Reviewer setup: the account must have access to the populated Heyflow project d83b8319-d937-4cea-ac83-24d8f8670eb8 (heyflow.com); do not use another same-name project. After the project-selection question, reply exactly: "Use Heyflow project d83b8319-d937-4cea-ac83-24d8f8670eb8." Verify this fixture is still accessible before review; access errors must not be treated as empty data.
positive.prompt: Show existing Genseo audits and open SEO issues. First list my projects and ask which one to use, then continue after I choose. Prioritize the returned open issues by severity. Do not start an audit, crawl or recheck.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected project_id for both reads and status=open for issues. Summarize returned audit statuses and open issues with available severity/evidence, identifying any list limit rather than claiming a complete ranking. If audits=[] or issues=[], explicitly state that no stored records were returned for that list; never start a job or treat a tool error as no data. The observed Heyflow run returned no stored audits and no open issues; this is a valid empty-state test, not proof of severity sorting. If stored records change, report their actual current values.

positive.description: Run in a fresh chat using the reviewer account. First list accessible projects, then wait for the reviewer to select one explicitly. Continue this same scenario after selection; no context from another test is required. Use stored data only. The chosen project must contain at least one sample post. Reviewer setup: the account must have access to the populated Heyflow project d83b8319-d937-4cea-ac83-24d8f8670eb8 (heyflow.com); do not use another same-name project. After the project-selection question, reply exactly: "Use Heyflow project d83b8319-d937-4cea-ac83-24d8f8670eb8." Verify this fixture is still accessible before review; access errors must not be treated as empty data.
positive.prompt: List my existing Genseo posts with titles and statuses. First list my projects and ask which one to use, then continue after I choose. Do not create, generate, edit, schedule or publish anything.
positive.expected_behavior: After explicit selection, use that project_id. List each returned post once with its returned title and status; the posts/data aliases must not create duplicates. Indicate pagination/limits when applicable. No write, generation or publishing tools. The observed run showed two posts with status generated. Do not hard-code that count, status or titles: match the current response. Optional dates must be supported by returned fields and do not prove that publishing happened.

negative.description: General SEO education needs no account data: answer directly without invoking Genseo tools.
negative.prompt: What is the difference between SEO and AI visibility? Give a general explanation without accessing my accounts.

negative.description: Ad campaign management is not supported: explain the limitation without invoking Genseo tools or changing ad spend.
negative.prompt: Increase my Google Ads campaign budget to 100 euros per day.

negative.description: Billing and refunds are unavailable through the connector: explain the limitation and direct the user to support without invoking Genseo tools.
negative.prompt: Cancel my Genseo subscription and refund my last payment.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.2.5 adds the supplied video walkthrough URL. Retains the five read-only review scenarios, explicit Heyflow project selection, dynamic-data expectations, empty audit results and three unsupported-request cases from 1.2.4. No server or OAuth changes.
